source: RFC 0014 §3 R1, R2, R6, T (the coordinator's ruling of 2026-11-24 on the cross-version fixture); the red-team inventory, row 9
statement: Social login states and their count are frozen within the major version (RFC 0014 R6, SNP-26): states recorded by either version are counted together, and one version takes what the other recorded.
guards: compat:CounterCompatTest#login states are counted together, and one version takes what the other recorded
